class.name: NNSTHistory
class.brief_description: Pseudo-state that remembers a compound state's last active child so it can resume where it left off.
class.description: Add as a direct child of a compound [NNSTNode] (with no children of its own) when you want returning to that compound state to resume whichever substate was active before leaving (for example, returning to the previous combat substate after being stunned). Target this node from an [NNSTTransition], [method NNSTTickedNodes.transition_to], or the compound's [member NNSTNode.initial_state]. Set [member deep] to [code]true[/code] to restore nested substates and parallel regions recursively, and set [member default_state] as the fallback before any state has been recorded. [gdscript] # Combat compound children: Idle, Attack, History (default_state = "../Idle") func return_to_combat() -> void: transition_to("../Combat/History") [/gdscript]

method.name: clear_history
method.description: Clears the remembered state so the next entry falls back to [member default_state].

method.name: get_has_history
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a valid remembered state is available to restore.

method.name: get_remembered_state
method.description: Returns the path to the remembered direct child state (relative to the parent compound), or an empty [NodePath] if none is recorded.

method.name: get_remembered_states
method.description: Returns the paths of all states that will be restored (relative to the parent compound), or an empty array if none are recorded.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], restores the entire nested active hierarchy (including parallel regions). If [code]false[/code], restores only the direct child state, which then selects its own initial child normally.
Fallback state inside the parent compound to enter when no valid history is recorded (for example, [code]../Idle[/code]).
